## Exponentials and Logarithms

In these notes,
$\logf{x}$ is the natural logarithm of $x > 0$,
the logarithm with base $e \approx 2.718$,
and $\expf{x} = e^x$ is the exponential function.
Some sources write $\ln x$ for the natural logarithm
and reserve $\log x$ for base 10.
